name: Layout Composer
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
description: Cartographic print layout designer for GeoLibre: page-size catalog in mm/cm/in/pt/px, live map frames with locked scale, custom shapes and per-frame layers, DMS/DD/UTM grids, inset maps, legends for vector, raster and tile layers, a Word-style ribbon (Insert, Format, Table Design/Layout, Map Frame, Grid), attribute tables and Plotly charts (21 kinds) from layer data, Mermaid diagrams, HTML blocks, a Symbol dialog, matplotlib-style color bars, dual-unit scale bars, 26 north arrows, LaTeX, drawing tools, Google Fonts and Material Symbols, Maki and Temaki icons, layout grids and precise editing, QGIS .qpt import/export, user templates, and PNG/JPG/PDF/vector PDF/GeoPDF/SVG export.
